gaussian_alpha1_plateau.independent_route: the noise phi from three other routes of dense_memory/rem_noise.py (Legendre transform of zeta, the minimised 1RSB functional over pattern labels bisected on (A25), Laplace's method on the rate function) agree with the closed form to 1e-30 (tests/test_dense_memory.py); the exact finite-N overlap law (sim.rem_phi_mc: Poisson counts per overlap bin, N = 100, 400, 1600) converges to it; and the paper's gradient descent run directly (sim.gd_retrieval, N = 200) retrieves above and collapses below the lam_1(alpha) built on it; alpha_1 also from the Legendre-dual closed form s(1) = 1/2 for lam >= s'(1) = 1
